cluster_relationships: PAGA undirected connectivity: GATA2+ cluster 1 neighbors megakaryocyte cluster 0 (0.32) and erythroid cluster 2 (0.21); CD34+ FLT3+ clusters 3/4 connect (0.57), with 3 near dendritic progenitor 11 (0.33) and early granulocyte/monocyte 5 (0.16); 5 connects neutrophil-primed 6 (0.59). Dendritic progenitor 11 weakly connects CD7+ dendritic-like 10 (0.12), then MHC-II+ 8 (0.14); 8 neighbors activated CCR7+ 9 (0.83). These are expression graph proximities, not validated lineage direction.
model: Unperturbed WT-like sorted and unsorted cohort; QC: one cell/well, >=350 detected genes, 500-14000 UMI, >=5 cells/gene; library-size 10000, log1p, 2500 HVG, scaled PCA 25 PCs, 20-neighbor graph, UMAP and Leiden resolution 0.55; Wilcoxon one-vs-rest BH markers; PAGA and root-dependent diffusion pseudotime. Sequencing batch evaluated but not regressed because confounded with sort/mouse.
